records.title: GM Isuzu 4JJ1 4JJ3 Rear Main Seal Installation Tool
model_lines: Izuzu: 3.5 Tonne / Mu / NKR69 /  NKR77 / NLR85 / NNR85 / Wizard / DMax
quality_flags: a Colorado is filed under Isuzu
model year embedded in a model name: 'Colorado 3.0L 4JX1 2008'
one seal number published four ways: 3-97071561 / 397071561 / 39707 1561 / 8-97071561
carries a negative constraint (Will NOT fit 4BE) that naive text search would read as a fit
alternative kit DM11-B1726 is named but its seat depth is never published
records.raw_text:
SKU: DM11-A1261
GM Isuzu 4JJ1 4JJ3 Rear Main Seal Installation Tool
$297.00 Inc. GST
This tool is specially designed to prevent oil seal damage during installation.

The seal will leak without using the correct tool!
The DM11-A1261 tool is generally for the early versions,

The best way to check is via the Seal Numbers as there are now two kits that may fit your vehicle, but also the depth the seal is pushed in. The other tool it may be is  DM11-B1726
These two tools are almost identical, the only difference we can find is the depth of where the seal is seated in the tool.

The depth for the DM11-A1261 is 12.2-12.8mm

This kit (DM11-A1261) will also fit some front crankshaft seals but again please check the seal number.

Models Suits:

Izuzu: 3.5 Tonne / Mu / NKR69 /  NKR77 / NLR85 / NNR85 / Wizard / DMax
Holden: Rodeo / Jackaroo
Isuzu D-MAX 4JJ3 2019 Onwards
Isuzu / Colorado 3.0L 4JX1 2008
Engines: 4JB1 / 4JH1 / 4JJ1 (130hp / 150 hp) / 4JG2 / 4JH1-TC / 4JJ1-TCS / 4JJ3 / 4JX1
NOTE: Will NOT fit 4BE

OEM Seal Number:  BZ4962-E / 3-97071561 / 397071561 / 39707 1561 / 8-97071561
Equivalent to Oil Seal Installer Tool: 5-8840-2359-0

records.raw_text:
SKU: DM11-B1008
Universal Wheel Bearing Removal and Installation Tool Kit
$643.50 Inc. GST
Wheel bearing extractor and installer tool that can be used to replaced wheels bearings "ON CAR" without removing the stub assembly and various knuckles that are attached.
This kit will work with any stub assembly that has a CV shaft running through the middle of it, even IRS systems.

NOTE: Must separate wheel hub first to access wheel bearing. Use in conjunction with DM11-C1095-5H

Great time saving tool!

Audi / VW 1.0L / 1.2L / 1.4L - TSI / TFSI Engine Timing Tool Kit - Blue motion (3 and 4 Cylinder) Petrol

For checking and adjusting engine timing on the newer belt driven petrol VW engines.

Includes the updated camshaft locking tool for vehicles after 2013 with CoD (Cylinder on Demand) feature.
